message.reasoning_content: Describe the kernel: recurrence with deliberate fp16 rounding each step — float16 accumulation over 512 steps, decay 0.999, bias 0.01. FP16 epsilon ~0.001 relative; steady state h ≈ b/(1-a) ≈ 0.01/0.001 = 10. FP16 quantization of ~10 gives step ~0.0078; relative error ~0.05% per step... Actually the key risk: fp16 rounding of h~10 yields absolute error up to 0.004, over 512 steps errors could accumulate but each stored. Also a*h in fp32 then rounded. Budget E<=0.003 relative to reference norm. Reference h around 10, sqrt(16384)=128, tolerance floor 0.128... E = ||diff||/max(||ref||,0.128). Likely fine but Skeptic should quantify. Also potential issue: h stored per step after rounding, so error bounded by fp16 quantization at steady state, no amplification since decay<1. Record description.
